answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with a slow-vesting bond. Each agent locks tokens on a public terrace of reputation, and a new identity only earns a trustworthy signal after surviving several epochs of costly bonding. Faking thousands of sybils means fronting real capital that vests like a comet's tail, burning on exit if behavior is malicious. Attackers must lock and lose substantial funds per fake identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational while honest agents recover stake over time.
